name: @battleplan/projects
description: Project Lambda: create a battleplan, store its Cursor chat link, and edit the title.

scripts.test:local: vitest run --config ../vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests --reporter=verbose projects && terraform -chdir=terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=terraform init -backend=false -input=false && terraform -chdir=terraform validate
scripts.test:agent: vitest run --config ../vitest.config.ts --passWithNoTests --reporter=junit --outputFile=../test-results/projects-agent.xml projects && terraform -chdir=terraform fmt -check -recursive && terraform -chdir=terraform init -backend=false -input=false && terraform -chdir=terraform validate
